referenceFunction.generalComment:
1 kg H2 produced using a PEM electrolyzer, produced in a hybrid solar PV/wind plant in Central Morocco (Latitude: 28.7, Longitude: -9.54). The hybrid plant has a lifetime of 30 years and produces 2.35 kilotons of hydrogen annually. 0.24 percent of the hydrogen mass produced is lost. 26.21 MW electrolyzer installation, with a capacity factor of 57%. 13 2-MW turbines are considered, for a total capacity of 26,272 kW, with a lifetime of 20 years and a 50% load factor and a curtailment factor of 2.3%. 28 570-kWp ground mounted PV units are considered, with a lifetime of 30 years, and a 22% load factor and a curtailment factor of 13.8%. A NMC stationary battery of 862 kWh of capacity is required, with a lifetime of 13 years. A water requirement of 24 liters per kg H2 is assumed, considering losses due to cleaning, cooling, but also significant evaporation -- see Tonelli et al., 2023. Stack lifetime [hours] 45'000 IndWEDe Stack lifetime [years] 5.5 IndWEDe, based on the lower estimate of 8,000 hours per year, from manufacturers' data. Balance of Plant lifetime [years]: Same as system. System lifetime [years]: 20 IndWEDe. Stack replacement over system's lifetime, excluding initial unit [unit] 3 Calculated. Water demand [kg water/kg H2] 8.9, corrected to 124 to represent extreme climatic consitions. Electricity demand [kWh/kg H2]: 54 IndWEDe. Electrical Efficiency [%, based on H2 LHV]: 61.7%: Productivity [kg H2/hour]: 18.52: From row above. Operating temperature [Â°C] 50-80 Manufacturers' data. Operating pressure [bar]: ~30 IndWEDe Produced amount over system's lifetime years [kg H2] 70.5 million tons.
